# Values that look service-specific but are genuinely org-wide, and so are
# allowed to appear verbatim in a prompt body.
#
# The pattern checks (GUID, work-item reference, email address, Kusto cluster
# host, Azure DevOps organization URL) fail the build by default. Add an entry
# here only when the value is a shared platform endpoint or identity that every
# consuming team uses identically -- never to silence a leak of your own
# service's resources.
#
# One value per line. Matching is a substring comparison in both directions.
#
# Empty by default: nothing in this library needs an exception.
